meta.name: agent-governance
meta.description: Agent islemlerini policy'ye gore denetle. Hassas islem oncesi governance kontrolu calistir. Tetikleyiciler: destructive komut, dosya sistemi erisimi, rate limit, butce kontrolu, trust score yonetimi.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在敏感操作前自动执行治理检查，防止越权行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代理执行危险操作前进行策略审核
copy.tagline_en: Automatically enforce governance checks before sensitive agent actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need policy-based governance before destructive agent operations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在执行敏感操作前检查策略文件，根据信任等级、文件系统权限、速率限制和预算等规则决定允许、警告或拒绝操作，并记录审计日志。
howto.when: 当 Claude 要执行破坏性命令、访问文件系统、触发速率限制或涉及预算控制等敏感操作时，会触发治理检查。

say.note: 触发破坏性操作警告，记录日志。

say.text: 查看 primary-agent 的信任分数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude checks a policy file before executing sensitive operations. Based on trust level, filesystem permissions, rate limits, and budget, it decides to allow, warn, or deny the action, and logs the audit trail.
howto.when_en: When Claude is about to execute destructive commands, access filesystem, trigger rate limits, or involve budget control, the governance check is triggered.

say_en.note: Triggers destructive action warning and logs.
